estilo: Circular vintage travel stamp illustration, screen-print poster style, flat colors with subtle grain and slight ink misregistration, limited palette of 5 colors (deep teal, warm green, brick red, mustard ochre, off-white), bold simplified shapes, clean thick outline around a perfect circle filling the square canvas, white background outside the circle, centered composition, no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no watermark.
